project_type: React SPA with TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS
test_framework: None configured (no test scripts in package.json)
build_command: cd dashboard && npx tsc --noEmit (type-check only, no npm install available)
verification_instructions: TypeScript type-checking only. Cannot install deps or run build in INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode.
setup_instructions: N/A - INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode. Node.js 22 available but no npm install possible.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no npm install, no runtime verification. Code must be structurally correct TypeScript/React that will compile when dependencies are available. Git push works.
contribution_requirements: All new code in /projects/sandbox/NVLabsCompany/dashboard/. Only modify App.tsx (add route) and Sidebar.tsx (add nav link) from existing files. Do NOT modify any Python backend files.
key_patterns: Pages export named function components. Hooks use useApi() wrapper with usePolling() for auto-refresh. API modules export objects with CRUD methods. Types in src/types/. COMPANY_ID from src/config.ts. Path alias @/ maps to src/. Components in organized subdirectories. Lucide for icons. Tailwind for styling. Cards/Badge/StatusIndicator reusable components.
directory_structure: dashboard/src/ contains: api/ (API client modules), components/ (layout/, common/, charts/, agents/, tasks/, org/, governance/, evolution/, activity/), hooks/ (useApi, useAgents, usePolling), pages/ (16 page components), types/ (agent, task, company, evolution, common), config.ts
